title: The playlist screen
hints: `map` turns each item into something else; `filter` keeps the items whose callback returns `true`. Both return a new array and leave the input alone.

`songTitles` is `songs.map((s) => s.title)`, and `byArtist` is a `filter` comparing `s.artist === artist`. `titlesBy` can reuse `byArtist` and then `map`. For `countMatching`, replace `any` with a function type: `(song: Song) => boolean`.
function countMatching(songs: Song[], test: (song: Song) => boolean): number { let count = 0; for (const song of songs) { if (test(song)) count++; } return count; }
